title: AME-Derm: An Asymmetric Anatomical Mixture-of-Experts with a Data-Driven Rare-Class Verification Algorithm for Dermoscopic Skin-Lesion Classification
description:
Reference implementation and reproducible result artifacts for AME-Derm, an asymmetric anatomical mixture-of-experts for dermoscopic skin-lesion classification. A single large DINOv2 generalist is combined with three zone-specific experts (torso, limb, head) through a static fusion weight and six-view test-time augmentation; a data-driven rare-class verification cascade then restores precision on classes too scarce to correct by retraining.

The repository contains the full pipeline (lesion segmentation, lesion-grouped 5-fold splits, expert training, MoE evaluation, external validation on BCN20000/ISIC2019, and a protocol-matched comparison against the PanDerm foundation model), together with the raw per-fold and per-sample outputs behind the paper's tables and a script that regenerates those tables without a GPU.

Published article: Array 32 (2026) 101409.
